structured.answer: After 8 years (500 ₪ a month, the page's default) the calculator says about 68,853 ₪ stays in my hands, from 48,000 I put in. For 4 years it gives no figure for self-employed people ("לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים"), only that you pay tax, so I'd ask the bank or my son.

stuck.why: A number (25,725) appeared over an empty dashed box whose label was half hidden by the round 'back to top' button. I nearly took it for the fund's amount.
The bars for years 1-5 are empty for self-employed people, so there is no answer for 4 years

Calculator 'כמה כסף נשאר לכם, ומתי?' with the עצמאים switch

findings.what: There is no figure for withdrawing before 6 years for self-employed people, so the question about 4 years can't be answered
At year 4 a number (25,725) still appears over an empty dashed box, which is easy to mistake for the fund's amount
The round 'back to top' button covers the label of the comparison column
Small grey hint text is hard to read on the dark background
Dark green and dark brown segments in the bars are hard to tell apart
'מסלול מדד' is unexplained jargon, and to me מדד means the price index
The whole page has a dark background, which tires older eyes
